title: vc-rollup: companion artifact for Joint anonymized issuance and revocation for complex verifiable credential chains
description: Companion artifact for the 2026 TDK paper by Kocsis Csillag Kamilla. Implements credential query proofs, three accumulators, hidden issuance and atomic compare-and-swap updates under a trusted issuer/updater model. Includes local reproduction and historical OP Sepolia evidence; see design/ARTIFACT-CONTRACT.md for scope and limitations.
